data_only_rank.interpretation: Gram spectrum can lose precision in weakest modes. Anchors select D units; data alone leaves slope/A scale null. Learned template may add weak or ambiguous modes.
data_only_rank.method: framewise data-only theta/A projection includes P1 and P4; no priors/bounds; native equal-pattern weights, declared parameter characteristic units

interpretation: One frozen sharedphysical P1/P4 g. All calibration/prior targets exclusively active barrel-first Stages1..4. Paired immutable fixed-size control used only as initial point. Exactly one shared template size DOF added, no size prior or second g. Data-only slope/A ambiguity and capture/demand confounding remain.
optical_anchor_policy: FreshStage04 alpha/offset andStage03s0 only; mean14 standardized squares with widths 1.0 times [.05,10deg,abs(s0)]; template shape and size no prior. Numerical size ratio bounds [.5,2] do not assert physical size constraints. Individual Gaussian interpretation includes sqrt14 averaging factor. Raw coefficients same model/gauge; Original17 characteristic gradient certificate units unchanged; appended logsize characteristic unit .01.
order: forward D(K(B)); inverse barrel FIRST then K
selection_policy: Lowest loss among valid starts meeting both unchanged state/global stationarity certificates; uncertified lower finite starts not promoted
stage_gate: stationary barrel-first anchor sensitivity conditional estimator
